collection.network_owner_source: auditd:lab_connect SOCKADDR/SYSCALL correlated by PID and time
collection.caveat: Raw Sysmon EID 3 Image is not used as the Linux owner because it can survive a rapid exec. Where Sysmon emitted no EID 3 during the sensor re-home, the retained auditd connect and SOCKADDR records are the owner evidence.

flows.name: generated Linux Gopher agent over mTLS
operator_actions: Fetch the reviewed ELF from Kali HTTP as /opt/lab/run/.cache/telemetry-helper and verify SHA-256.
Execute the renamed ELF directly and confirm its Kali-only Gopher mTLS session.
Task pwd, ls /opt/lab/run, ps, and download of the fixed 30-byte marker, then task exit.

signals: chmod changed the ELF mode before execution

registry.reason: Linux has no Windows Registry analogue.

deep.reason: The permitted Gopher built-ins executed in-process; no shell child, process access, injection, named pipe, or kernel-module signal was produced.

schedule.interpretation: Gopher holds a continuous task connection; no Beacon callback periodicity exists to measure.

flows.name: masquerading sysmon.service persistence
operator_actions: Re-home the genuine sensor as lab-sysmon-sensor.service so telemetry remains available.
Replace sysmon.service, daemon-reload, enable it, and start it.
Verify both the sensor unit and masquerading unit, the latter's PID, hashes, and absent dpkg ownership.
Repeat under the verified lab-only IPv4/IPv6 guard after the first safety check was inconclusive on unattributed Ubuntu background traffic.

unit.package_ownership: none for unit or ExecStart target

process.signal: auditd serials 10428 and 11123 recorded PID 1 exec of the renamed ELF as root; ppid=1 is the stable ancestry field
process.note: The guarded rerun's collected Sysmon process JSON was empty during the service transition, so auditd is the authoritative positive process source.

network.signal: Zeek recorded the service agent connection to 192.168.1.50:19443; auditd lab_connect serials 10429 and 11124 attribute the corresponding SOCKADDR to the renamed ELF with uid/euid 0.

signals: retained unit content proves the Sysmon-name/ExecStart mismatch

registry.reason: Linux has no Windows Registry analogue.

deep.signal: auditd tied systemd parentage, the hidden ExecStart target, and the Kali-only connect; no process injection, module load, or named-pipe activity occurred.

upstream_systemd_rule_noise.interpretation: The upstream rule caught the masquerading unit but also the benign sensor re-home; it detects unit creation generally and cannot express the security-name/ExecStart mismatch.

flows.name: DNS transport lab-only listener and source-faithful profile preflight
operator_actions: Set systemd-resolved exclusively to 192.168.1.50 with routing domain ~. and DNS-over-TLS disabled.
Install and verify IPv4 and IPv6 OUTPUT guards before starting the listener.
Start a non-forwarding BeaconDNS listener on Kali for adaptix.lab and issue bounded source-faithful heartbeat-shaped probes.
Stop the listener without generating or executing an agent.

process.reason: No Linux DNS-capable agent exists in the reviewed release and no agent was executed.

network.signal: All DNS requests terminated at Kali 192.168.1.50:53; the source-faithful pcap contains 12 resolver-duplicated A query rows derived from five unique heartbeat sequence values.
network.guard: IPv4 permitted only loopback and 192.168.1.50; IPv6 permitted loopback only; four background packets were rejected during the source-faithful capture.

file.signal: auditd recorded the temporary systemd-resolved drop-in and run evidence files; no payload was written.

registry.reason: Linux has no Windows Registry analogue.

deep.reason: Listener/profile validation generated no endpoint execution, persistence, child-process, or process-access signal.

doh.reason: No lab-hosted DoH endpoint compatible with the reviewed Windows-only Beacon client was available; public defaults were forbidden and never contacted.
